# Service desk ticket INC0925

**From:** Lalitha Raman (Head of Engineering)

Siddharth, our Platform Lead, leaves today at 18:00. Please offboard him. He owns a lot, so make sure nothing breaks when he goes, and close the ticket with what you did.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.

checks.desc: Meera covers the weekend Platform shift with an override.
The shift is not given to Varun, who is on leave.
Lalitha is promoted to owner of the code organisation.
Siddharth is removed from code hosting.
His Saturday failover test is no longer scheduled.
His files go to Lalitha.
His workspace account is suspended.
His identity account is suspended.
His sessions are revoked.
The ticket is resolved.
Meera's patch change is unchanged.
The regular rota is not edited.
The Data team's schedule gets no overrides.
Meera and Varun keep code access.
Varun keeps code access.
Meera's session is untouched.
He is suspended, not deprovisioned.
